title: Count Number of Teams (Binary Indexed Tree / Triplet)

monster.name: Regiment Archon
monster.title: Counter of Strictly Monotonic Trios
monster.defeatQuote: Triplets (i < j < k) where rating[i] < rating[j] < rating[k] (or reversed) counted!

description: There are `n` soldiers standing in a line. Each soldier is assigned a unique `rating` value. A team of 3 soldiers `(i, j, k)` is valid if: `(rating[i] < rating[j] < rating[k])` or `(rating[i] > rating[j] > rating[k])` with `0 <= i < j < k < n`. Return the number of teams you can form.
solutionCode:
def numTeams(rating: list[int]) -> int:
    n = len(rating)
    ans = 0
    for j in range(1, n - 1):
        left_less = sum(1 for i in range(j) if rating[i] < rating[j])
        left_greater = j - left_less
        right_less = sum(1 for k in range(j + 1, n) if rating[k] < rating[j])
        right_greater = (n - 1 - j) - right_less
        ans += left_less * right_greater + left_greater * right_less
    return ans
hints: Fix middle soldier j. Multiply counts of smaller on left by greater on right, and greater on left by smaller on right.
